main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (3-bar return minus coin mean 3-bar return) on Sunday cases
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with the supporting check), t <= -2 rejects, over at least 200 cases

supporting_check.name: thin minus heavy weekend-volume half, strength (fade-direction unusual 3-bar move / usual 3-bar move), Welch t >= 1

decided_by: The main t is 2 or more but the thin-minus-heavy Welch t is below 1 (or could not be computed), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are bars starting on a UTC Sunday with a non-zero forecast and a full 3-bar return inside the window; the coin's mean and usual 3-bar move come from the non-overlapping grid 0,3,6,... of each window pooled over its windows; the volume factor is the mean volume of bars t-21..t-2 over the mean of bars t-1 and t, thin half above the pooled median and heavy half at or below it; the fade direction is the forecast's sign.
